---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new rule, output option, or improvement to skill-guard
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? A clear and concise description of the situation, for example "I scan `.cursor/rules/**` but skill-guard does not flag X".

## Proposed solution

Describe the change you would like to see. If it is a new detection, say which kind of risk it covers (prompt injection, credential exfiltration, dangerous shell, network egress, MCP misconfiguration, or other) and which files it should inspect.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, such as an existing rule with `--disable` or `--allow-host`, a custom pattern, or a workaround outside the tool, and why they are not enough.

## Additional context

Any other context, examples of skill files (with secrets removed), screenshots, or links to related issues or external specifications.
